items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I said, well, Dan, what you got to do about the red beans and rice?

ctx.x: Yeah, with a little kazoo band. Yeah. So finished down there, they joined, they asked me to join. I said, well, you know what they done? They put a basket for me and they brought me. They made me join the masons. Well, I stayed in there and after they put the basket for me and paid my fears, one black ball can kill you. Yeah. But I didn't know that. But then they joined me and I had no friends, no enemies, all white balls. Turn around, I went to class of crystal. Went and take them out to the first degree. I…

Well, I was asking about your wife singing. I guess that's how we got into that. Oh, yeah. First, I was wondering if there's anything else about the guitar. You can tell in the old days, did they just hit the four beats usually? Or how did they do? The oldest guitar players you've ever heard? Well, I'll tell you.
